customReplacement.reason: The owner-approved Optical Printer Bench system was already healthy. This pass preserved it while correcting lifecycle truth, responsive proof, and metadata.

contract.purpose: Explain a held local-first Mac experiment that turns editing intent into reproducible effect variants, show the working native evidence, and state the exact condition for reopening it.
contract.purposeSource: PRODUCT.md, PROJECT_STATUS.md, and the canonical Site Health project dossier
contract.canonicalPurpose: Local AI Video Studio helps a creator compare reproducible local video effects before choosing and exporting a result.
contract.audience: Technical creators using Apple silicon Macs who want deterministic local editing options before paying for generative video.
contract.job: Understand the import, plan, compare, and export loop; verify local processing and graph constraints; inspect real native proof; and understand why the experiment is held.
contract.thesis: An optical-printer contact sheet keeps media and exact graph differences more prominent than AI controls or editor chrome.
contract.system: Owner-approved black machinery and daylight stock, fired-clay probe marks, oxidized-teal ready states, square media wells, system type, monospace measurements, and restrained responsive crops.
contract.signature: One source becomes equal studies under a shared probe, with every fallback and normalized graph difference attached to the image it affects.
contract.risk: A polished working build can look distribution-ready, so the hero and release desk must state the held lifecycle, closed download, and recurring-workflow reopen condition.

projectCheck.command: npm run quality:site && npm run quality
projectCheck.note: The complete native and site quality gate passes. Final 390, 768, and 1440 renders were inspected after stacking phone studies and adding focused native proof for phone and tablet.

findings: Baseline independent review found two P1 defects: lifecycle copy implied active distribution, and core proof degraded on phone and tablet. Both are resolved in the final candidate.
Residual P2: the mobile page is long because it preserves all four workflow stages and two separate native proof views.

comprehension.reviewer: Independent fresh-visitor baseline and revised review by Harvey

answers.product: Local AI Video Studio is a held, local-first Mac experiment for comparing reproducible video-effect studies.
answers.audience: It is for technical creators on Apple silicon Macs who want deterministic effects before generative video.
answers.value: It lets a creator compare exact edit differences before selecting and exporting one result.
answers.mechanism: One local clip moves through deterministic planning, synchronized variants, a validated effect graph, and revision-matched export.
answers.proof: Real native captures show rendered variants, visible fallbacks, normalized graph differences, and the registered effect catalog.
answers.nextAction: Treat it as held with no public download, and reopen only for a recurring creator workflow where deterministic local effects clearly help.

ownerFeedback.note: The operator delegated priority-aware end-to-end landing qualification without repeated approval loops. This receipt records a qualified local candidate, not deployment authorization.
